<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item+)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % pe " <!ENTITY ent 'parameterized'> ">
  %pe;
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
  <?target-pi data="processing-instruction-value"?>
]>
<catalog xmlns="http://example.com/ns/catalog" xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude">
  <!-- Main catalog comment block with entities & ent; -->
  <item>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section containing unparsed markup: <item>&ent;</item>
    ]]>
  </item>
</catalog>

<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base "RootEntity">
  <!ENTITY extended "&base;Extended">
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
]>
<root xmlns="http://default.namespace.org" xmlns:custom="http://custom.namespace.org">
  <!-- Comprehensive comment explaining the following structure -->
  <?custom-pi test-attribute="value"?>
  <custom:child>
    <![CDATA[
      Nested CDATA block with entity reference: &extended;
    ]]>
  </custom:child>
</root>
```

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (stock*)>
  <!ELEMENT stock (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY stock-prefix "STK-">
  <!ENTITY item-code "&stock-prefix;999">
  <?inventory-mgmt status="active"?>
]>
<inventory xmlns="http://inventory.org/schema" xmlns:loc="http://inventory.org/loc">
  <!-- Inventory manifest comment -->
  <?loc:instruction region="north"?>
  <loc:stock>
    <![CDATA[
      Stock identifier details: &item-code;
    ]]>
  </loc:stock>
</inventory>
```

]>
<system xmlns="http://sys.org/core" xmlns:net="http://sys.org/net" xmlns:sec="http://sys.org/sec">
  <!-- System topology description comment -->
  <?net:config protocol="tcp" port="8080"?>
  <net:node>
    <![CDATA[
      Security credentials &sec:token; inside CDATA block for node &reference;
    ]]>
  </net:node>
</system>
